sku-mapping.title: SKU Mapping
sku-mapping.subtitle: Link each B2B organization's own codes (owner_sku) to the store's SKUs (vtex_sku). Imported mappings show up in the customer portal and the store right away.
sku-mapping.organization.label: Organization
sku-mapping.organization.no-organization: This account has no B2B organizations yet.
sku-mapping.organization.none-text: Each B2B organization has its own mappings. Choose one to see and import them.

sku-mapping.import.title: Import a file
sku-mapping.import.description: A CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file with two columns and the header owner_sku,vtex_sku: the organization's code, then the store SKU it points to. Codes already mapped are updated; codes missing from the file are kept.
sku-mapping.import.leading-zeros: Excel removes leading zeros from numbers (00123 becomes 123). If the codes start with 0, format the columns as Text or use the template.
sku-mapping.import.dropzone: Drop a CSV or XLSX file with owner_sku,vtex_sku here, or
sku-mapping.import.wrong-type: Choose a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file.
sku-mapping.import.too-big-xlsx: Excel files must be up to 10 MB. Save the sheet as CSV to import larger files.
sku-mapping.import.too-big-csv: CSV files must be up to 50 MB. Split the file and import each part.
sku-mapping.import.unreadable: The file could not be read.
